description: What is the solar flux index today? Returns the latest daily 10.7 cm solar radio flux (F10.7, in solar flux units), the standard solar activity measure radio amateurs use for HF band conditions, from NOAA SWPC, with a rough HF conditions guide. It is a single daily value; actual propagation also depends on Kp, time of day and season. (cost: 1 credit)
name: solar_flux_10cm
